title: The dizziness of freedom
idea: Kierkegaard called anxiety the dizziness of freedom. The feeling comes from having real choices, so it points at what matters.
apply: When anxious before a decision, ask which possibility is making you dizzy, and take one small step toward it.
remind: Anxiety can be a sign that your choice matters.
who: Marco, who cannot decide whether to leave his safe job.

scenes.nar: Marco has a safe job and a dream of starting his own studio. For months, he just keeps thinking about it.

msgs.x: Something must be wrong with me.

scenes.nar: Whenever he imagines leaving, anxiety spikes. He wonders what is wrong with him.
Kierkegaard called anxiety the dizziness of freedom. Marco reads his as a sign that the choice matters, and takes one small step: a one page plan.
Six months later, he has two pilot clients and a part time job as a safety net. The dizziness settles as he moves.
